worldcombat.skill.muddywater.summary: Sweeps a low, ground-hugging wall of muddy water forward: it washes over a wide arc ahead, hits every foe in it, may foul their eyes and drop their accuracy, and keeps spreading past the main target. The swept ground is left muddy. Silting reaches wider, sticks longer and clings harder; the rapid torrent is heavier, faster and longer ranged.
worldcombat.skill.muddywater.use.0: Foul a whole rank of foes ahead in one sweep
worldcombat.skill.muddywater.use.1: Drag down a target's accuracy to open a window for the next exchange
worldcombat.skill.muddywater.use.2: Leave a mark on the ground where the wave washed through
worldcombat.skill.muddywater.description: The wave strikes a target for about %1$s special damage; each enemy is struck only once, and has a %2$s chance to lose %3$s accuracy stage(s).
The wave spreads over a %1$s degree arc ahead, reaches %2$s blocks, and pushes forward from your feet in %3$s steps.

A target fouled by the water has its attacks weakened (attack damage reduced by 15%%), and its accuracy stages drop with it - a stat change that stays for the rest of the encounter until it is cleared or the encounter ends. The mud itself lasts %1$s, ending when it expires or is cleared.
Once the wave settles, the ground it swept is left muddy for %1$s; one wave can foul at most %2$s foes.
worldcombat.skill.muddywater.silted.on: Silting: arc x1.35, murk chance +12%, up to 2 stages, longer murk and mud; costs power x0.85, range -1.5 blocks, slower advance, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +6 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.muddywater.silted.off: Rapid torrent: power x1.12, range +1.5 blocks and a faster advance; costs murk chance -6% and shorter murk and mud (mud x0.7).
worldcombat.skill.muddywater.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.muddywater.growth.0: From level %1$s the wave power rises to %2$s and the murk chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.muddywater.growth.1: From level %1$s the wave power rises to %2$s, the arc to %3$s degrees and the murk duration to %4$s.
On: arc x1.35, murk chance +12%, up to 2 accuracy stages, longer murk and ground mud, for sealing off an area; costs power x0.85, range -1.5 blocks, a slower advance, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +6 ticks. Off (rapid torrent): power x1.12, range +1.5 blocks and a faster advance, at the cost of murk chance -6% and shorter murk and mud (mud x0.7).
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: when other foes stand inside the arc ahead, this wave ranks higher so it fouls a whole rank; off: every target ranks by plain attack order.
